title: Fermi-LAT Burst Advocate Alert
description: Fermi-LAT alerts reporting burst detections and related analysis results.

seed.description: Instrument or pipeline that provided the seed trigger, e.g., GBM.

theta.description: Angular separation between the source direction and the instrument boresight [deg].

sun_distance.description: Angular separation between the source and the Sun [deg].

irf.description: Instrument response function used in the analysis.

trigger_analysis.description: Source detection analysis results for different time intervals.

trigger_significance.description: Maximum Test Statistic (TS) obtained in the analysis.

max_energy_photon.description: Energy of the highest-energy photon detected from the source [GeV].

energy_band_counts.description: Photon counts measured in individual energy bands.

counts.description: Number of detected photons in the energy band.
